text:
Sara M: Hey team — quick heads up. My flight out of SFO just got delayed and I can’t guarantee I’ll be able to cover the 19:00-03:00 UTC primary window tonight. Sorry for the late ping. Can someone pick up primary? I can shadow early part of the shift (19:00-21:00) but need a hard cut at 21:00.

Jamie L: I can take primary for the 21:00-03:00 slice if that helps. Could you paste the latest runbook pointers and any active watches? I’m slightly short on context for embeds latency.

Sara M: Thanks @Jamie. Current watchlist: spike in embed-encoder latency on us-west-2 over last 30m (p95 from 120 -> 420ms), a few user-visible retries. No active customer pages yet but we’ve seen increase in error budget burn.

Sara M: Runbook snippet:```
1) Check runtime pool health: /infra/runtime/pools
2) Restart slow workers: kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-encoder -n prod
3) Validate KV cache warm: redis-cli --latency -h redis-usw2-main
4) If retries continue, failover to smaller model variant: /deployments/model-routing -> promote embed-encoder-v2-lite
5) Escalation: ping SRE pager + eng-lead if >10% error increase for 15m
```

Derek P: I can be secondary for the night and take over immediate paging. @Sara can you drop the exact pd escalation policy link? I’ll standby 19:30->03:30.

Sara M: pd escalation: https://pd.company.com/policies/infra-embeds-escalate (copy)

Ops Bot: Pager assignment note: attaching temporary coverage tags. Current PD on-call: sara.m (primary) until 21:00. New assignment pending confirmation.

Incident Bot: Alert raised: embed-encoder latency anomaly (alert id: ALERT-2026-3421). Current state: Google Cloud metrics crossing threshold. Triggers: p95 latency > 300ms for 10m.

Jamie L: Ok reading runbook. Quick Q: do we have warm fallback model staged in eu region? If west is noisy we might route small fraction to eu for reduced latency while we fix.

Sara M: We have embed-encoder-v2-lite staged in us-east, not eu. Routing policy allows cross-region but will increase token egress cost. Given current metric trend, prefer rolling restart + KV cache flush first.

Derek P: If we restart workers, remember to check autoscaler cooldown, otherwise rollback pile-up. Also watch for queue depth — if it spikes we should enable backpressure with 503->retry-after via router flag.

Jamie L: Good call. I’ll start the restart sequence at 20:55 so we can observe pre-cutover behavior. Derek, can you watch PD and handle immediate pages during 21:00-22:00 while I fully assume primary?

Derek P: Yep I’ll be on pages. If anything escalates >15min I’ll bring eng-lead @Rachel in.

Sara M: Thanks both. Quick checklist before handoff: 
- I’ll post runbook link and active traces
- I’ll remove my primary tag in PD at 21:00
- Jamie to confirm takeover message in this thread at 21:00

Jamie L: Confirming — I will post a primary takeover at 21:00. Plan: rollout restart embed-encoder in canary -> monitor p95 and error-rate -> full rollout if stable. If not stable, failover to lite variant and notify support.

Ops Bot: PD update: sara.m removed as primary at 21:02. Jamie L assigned primary 21:02-03:00. Derek P assigned secondary 19:30-03:30.

Jamie L: Primary takeover complete. I’m live on pager (21:02). I’ve kicked off canary restart on a single pod. Monitoring dashboard: https://metrics.company.com/d/embed-encoder

Derek P: Saw the canary restart. No pages yet. I’m keeping eye on queue depth and error budget.

Incident Bot: New incident note appended to ALERT-2026-3421 by Jamie L: performed canary restart at 21:05; observing p95 drop from 420ms -> 190ms on canary.

Jamie L: Canary looks good, ramping to 20% after 5m of stability. If metrics hold we’ll continue to 100% in 10m steps.

Sara M: Huge appreciate the coverage. I’ll stay reachable by DM if you need config creds or KMS unlock (I have ephemeral keys until 22:30).

Derek P: Copy. If it’s needed after 22:30 we’ll escalate to SRE eng-lead. Also, leaving a quick runbook pointer in case of regression:
- rollback: kubectl rollout undo deployment/embed-encoder -n prod --to-revision=<prev>
- promote lite: clusterctl apply -f model-routing-lite.yaml

Jamie L: All good so far. No customer pages. I’ll update thread on each step and close out once fully stable.

Sara M: Thanks again — confirmed I’m free after 21:00. Good luck team :thumbsup:
